summary: Season 12 (2025/26) works team. No front-shirt sponsor: the brand in the team name ('Mahindra Racing') is the owner's own (Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd bought the team company, Mahindra Racing UK Ltd, outright in FY26), following the Porsche Formula E precedent of not listing the works brand as a sponsor; the partners page also carries a 'MAHINDRA & MAHINDRA LTD' entry (no partner type), that same works brand, which is excluded on that basis. Every other partner named on the team's official partners page is listed: Valvoline (named Official Partner in the M12Electro launch release), Tech Mahindra, Shell, Nippon Audio, Pininfarina, one8, Castore, Rockfort Engineering, OMP, Coral Eyewear and Technogym. Formula E teams have no shirt; partners sit on the car and team apparel, so all carry the schema's 'partner' placement.
